properties.answer: Approved (Anthony, 2026-07-25: "go with your recommendations. they are approved"). Build it: a seat is told the committed design moved before it writes. Warn-and-name rather than hard-refuse, since a claim never blocks anybody in this design (dec:advisory-concurrency) — the write proceeds once the mover is named and the divergence shown, the way git makes you look at a non-fast-forward.
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “A seat learns the shared design moved before it writes over it”
properties.question: When two people work on the same design at once, should reflow2 stop you and say so before you save over a version that has already moved on — the way git refuses a push that is out of date? Today it saves quietly, and the other person's work disappears without anyone seeing a conflict. Do you want that warning built, and should it refuse the write or only warn?
